who: A potter with a small shop. Throws in the week, sells at weekends, lives above it with a cat.

moments.plot: The winter market is in nine days and the blue bowls are not glazed.

tasks.title: Glaze the second batch of blue bowls
tasks.notes: Two thin coats. The first batch ran on three of them, so stop a finger above the foot.

tasks.title: Price list for the stall
tasks.notes: Round numbers. Seconds get their own basket and no label.

tasks.title: Find the photo of last year’s table
Bring a lamp, the corner is dark
Post the two parcels before noon

file.title: Borrow a card reader
file.notes: Ours drops out under the roof. Anouk had a spare one in {weekday-5}’s mess.

dated.title: Last glaze firing
dated.notes: Load on {weekday+3} evening. It needs two days to cool before anyone opens it.

repeating.title: Reclaim the clay bucket
repeating.notes: If it smells, it is already late.

attachments.notes: The one with the blue cloth, before it rained. Lurdes wants to copy the shelf. Measure the planks while you are at it.

tasks.title: Pick up the van from Anouk

agent.title: Answer the two shops that want bowls
agent.notes: Both asked for a wholesale price. We can make forty by spring, not sixty.
agent.question: Should both shops get the same price?
bodies: Hello, thank you for asking about the blue bowls. The wholesale price is €19 each, and I can have twenty ready for you by the end of March.
Hello, thank you for asking about the blue bowls. From twenty bowls the price is €19 each, and from thirty it is €17. I can deliver by the end of March.
agent.otherBody: Hello, thank you for asking about the blue bowls. I can have forty ready by spring. On the price: {answer}
agent.otherAnswer: Ten percent off for the café
agent.acceptance: Both shops know the price and the date.

discuss.title: Tell Anouk which corner we want
discuss.notes: Last year we had the dark one by the door. The plan for this year is attached to her email.
discuss.question: What matters most for the stall?
bodies: Hi Anouk, could we have a spot by the windows this time? The bowls looked grey all day in the corner by the door.
Hi Anouk, could we have a spot on the main aisle? We were behind the coffee queue last year and nobody came round the back.
discuss.otherBody: Hi Anouk, about the stall: we would like another spot this year. {answer}
discuss.acceptance: Anouk knows which spot we want.

review.title: Answer the two shops that want bowls
review.note: Two replies drafted. I left the delivery date as the end of March.

review.title: Add up the clay invoices
review.note: Nine invoices added. June has no invoice.

faded: Sort the glaze tests by year
Ask about the gallery in Évora
Try wood ash from the stove
